mapper.insert: INSERT INTO report_reply (num, content, created_date, report_num, admin_num) VALUES (report_reply_seq.NEXTVAL, #{content}, SYSDATE, #{report_num}, #{admin_num})
mapper.select: SELECT rr.num, rr.content, rr.created_date, rr.report_num, rr.admin_num FROM report_reply rr JOIN report r ON rr.report_num = r.num WHERE r.member_num = #{member_num} ORDER BY rr.num DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE report_reply SET content = #{content} WHERE num = #{num}
